currentConsumerFindings.catalogFields: The 102 catalog regions contain normalizedPageRect (61 array, 41 object) but no per-region coordinate-space, source-frame, renderer, or DPI tag. Each group’s catalog, region, source page, target image, current owner, image SHA, dimensions, focus hash, and content hash is listed above.
currentConsumerFindings.v6DiagnosticProjection: tools/source-frame-candidate-resolver-v6.py computes normalizedRectProjectedEdges for both renderers using page.rect width/height. That is a CropBox/page.rect projection even for Poppler full-page renders of MediaBox. The exact matcher is independent of that projection and its 9 locations match the fresh replay; the stored delta is not evidence that the current crop rectangle is wrong.
currentConsumerFindings.offlineGeometryAuditors: research/source-visual-audit.py rect_for() and research/source-raster-boundary-audit.py _catalog_region_geometry()/rect_to_pixels() use normalizedPageRect multiplied by page.rect (CropBox). This matches the DMG p. 75/76 CropBox-normalized declarations but does not represent the PHB printed pp. 27/37 crops in the Poppler MediaBox raster frame. The current raster snapshot has 1 such p. 27 usage and 10 p. 37 usages. Their stored boundary boxes differ from the fresh MediaBox placements by 8/15 pixels (p. 27) and 1/15 pixels (p. 37) at 300 DPI, so those band candidates need frame-aware recomputation before interpreting them as text clipping. Candidate statuses remain unresolved; this proposal does not label any of them clipped or repaired.
currentConsumerFindings.liveYourPdfMode: dist/books.js maps DMG printed p. 75→PDF 76 and p. 76→PDF 77; PHB printed p. N→PDF N+1 for these pages. dist/source-viewer.js Your PDF mode renders the entire user-selected PDF page using that page mapping, and excerpt mode displays the already-published image with image-relative focusRects. Neither mode reads normalizedPageRect. The nine adjudicated bounds therefore do not reveal a current live page-navigation or excerpt-rendering defect.
currentConsumerFindings.visualReviewHashBehavior: tools/source-visual-coverage.mjs regionHashes() includes every region field except focusRects in contentSha256. The 102 current owner bindings have unchanged, matching source/image/focus/content hashes; crop/context are independently confirmed for all 102, highlight is confirmed for 73 and missing for 29, and default assessment is absent for all 102. The existing p. 27/p. 37 crop/context/highlight evidence describes the visible paragraph/table/focus and says it was compared with the original PDF; it does not declare a normalizedPageRect basis, renderer/DPI, or historic crop recipe. Therefore no prior review is being promoted to a coordinate-frame approval. A detached sidecar leaves these review hashes unchanged. Adding coordinate-space metadata into each catalog region would change 102 content hashes and stale 102 binding-specific review records; that would require explicit re-review/re-hashing rather than carrying forward approval.
currentConsumerFindings.prospectiveBoundaryRepairScope: The exact, frozen before-state records for the PHB printed p. 27 one-owner row and p. 37 ten-owner rows are embedded at currentBeforeBoundaryFixture.rows (11 total), together with their current catalog/region/source/image/focus/content hashes, source-raster usages, source-visual-audit usages, and the two original geometry records. Inputs are hash-pinned there. They are targets for a future frame-aware recomputation only; this adjudication does not alter any candidate status or semantic conclusion.

proposal.activeNormalizedPageRectValues: Retain current values; no evidence supports changing their numeric bounds.
proposal.frameEvidenceBridge: Add a separate, versioned source-frame sidecar keyed by candidateGeometryId and current catalog+region IDs. Store raw normalizedPageRect, explicit normalized basis (CropBox/page.rect, MediaBox, or equal-box page), source PDF SHA, PDF ordinal and observed folio, renderer/runtime/DPI, full-frame raw RGB SHA and dimensions, exact pixelLTRB, catalog and PNG hashes/dimensions, and the current region focus/content hash. Scope the bridge to these nine current geometries and their 102 listed owner bindings. Do not alter semantic/crop/highlight approval statuses.
proposal.consumerRepair: When a follow-on audit uses normalizedPageRect to project into a source raster, require an explicit frame basis. For Poppler default full-page output use MediaBox coordinates; for PyMuPDF default page.rect use CropBox coordinates. Translate CropBox-normalized DMG locations by CropBox position when comparing them with MediaBox renders. Recompute the 11 PHB p. 27/p. 37 raster boundary bands under the right frame, retaining the old snapshot as history.
proposal.reviewHashImpact: External sidecar only: no existing region review hash changes and no crop/highlight re-review is required for unchanged images/focus/content. In-catalog coordinate tags or numeric edits: all 102 affected owner records would be stale under current contentHash rules and need review-record refresh.

remainingUnmatchedQueue.groupingKey: Same book, PDF page, image SHA, normalizedPageRect schema/value, and native dimensions; geometry keys are generated with the pinned v6 geometry_key().
remainingUnmatchedQueue.qualification: All listed items had no exact template in the v6–v8 bounded render sets. This is not proof of source absence, transform exhaustion, or resolution of the historical 726-member cohort.

limits: Exact RGB identity locates the current image in a current rendering of a hash-verified PDF; it does not establish that the image contains all relevant context, that its crop is semantically appropriate, that a focus rectangle is correct, or that the region is a valid citation for an owner field.

The inferred coordinate basis describes the best-supported current normalized-rectangle interpretation under the observed exact render. It does not reconstruct the historical crop authoring recipe or source-render process.

The v6–v8 candidate sets are finite. DPI, renderer, color handling, PDF box selection, affine transforms, or historical source processes outside those tried remain possible. No whole-population or historical-census completeness claim is made.
The 49 unmatched references / 47 geometries remain a portable next-review queue; no no-match result is promoted to absent-from-source.
No production/source metadata, coordinates, owners, images, citation fields, or review status was changed.

coordinateSpaceTags.meaning: normalizedPageRect fractions use PyMuPDF page.rect/CropBox dimensions and origin; translate by CropBox position before comparing to a Poppler MediaBox raster.
normalizedPageRect fractions map to PDF MediaBox frame; this is the best-supported current basis on the PHB pages whose MediaBox is 3.6 pt wider than CropBox.
CropBox and MediaBox coincide; page.rect normalization is geometrically unambiguous for this observed frame.

typedFrameSidecarProposal.authoringAndApprovalLimits: The bridge records exact current source/image/frame relationships; it does not claim a historic renderer/DPI recipe, completeness of excerpt context, semantic crop approval, or highlight/default approval. It must not promote source-excerpt review statuses.

sourceVisualAuditUsageBefore.regionTitle: PHB p. 27 · Thief scroll-reading ability at 10th level
sourceVisualAuditUsageBefore.regionSummary: Complete right-column entries 2–3 on PHB p. 27. Entry 3 states that 10th-level thieves decipher magical writings and use scrolls except clerical (but not druidic) scrolls, and gives a 25% misunderstanding chance. The focus covers the entry through “misunderstood”; the remaining sentence on reversed scroll spells is visible context.
